tools.name: slack_health
tools.description: Check the health and connectivity status of the Slack server.

tools.name: slack_search_public
tools.description: Search for messages across all public Slack channels using a required query string, with optional limit, cursor, content_types, response_format, include_context flag, and sort/sort_dir.

tools.name: slack_search_public_and_private
tools.description: Search for messages across both public and private Slack channels the user can access, using a required query string, with optional limit, cursor, content_types, response_format, include_context flag, and sort/sort_dir.

tools.name: slack_search_users
tools.description: Search for Slack users by a required query string, with optional limit, cursor, and response_format.

tools.name: slack_search_channels
tools.description: Search for Slack channels using a required query string, with optional limit, cursor, channel_types filter, include_archived flag, and response_format.

tools.name: slack_search_emojis
tools.description: Search for custom emoji in the Slack workspace by a required query string.

tools.name: slack_read_channel
tools.description: Read messages from a specific Slack channel by required channel_id, with optional limit, cursor, and response_format.

tools.name: slack_read_thread
tools.description: Read all replies in a specific Slack message thread, identified by required channel_id and message_ts, with optional limit, cursor, and response_format.

tools.name: slack_read_file
tools.description: Retrieve the content and metadata of a specific file shared in Slack by its required file_id.

tools.name: slack_read_user_profile
tools.description: Retrieve the full profile information of a Slack user by optional user_id, with optional include_locale flag and response_format.

tools.name: slack_list_channel_members
tools.description: List all members of a specific Slack channel by required channel_id, with optional limit, cursor, include_bots, include_deleted flags, and response_format.

tools.name: slack_read_canvas
tools.description: Read the content of a Slack canvas (collaborative document) by its required canvas_id.

tools.name: slack_get_reactions
tools.description: Retrieve all emoji reactions on a specific Slack message, identified by required channel_id and message_ts.

tools.name: slack_send_message
tools.description: Send a new message to a Slack channel by required channel_id with required message text, plus optional thread_ts for replies, reply_broadcast flag, and draft_id.

tools.name: slack_send_message_draft
tools.description: Save a message draft in a Slack channel by required channel_id with required message text, plus optional thread_ts for threading.

tools.name: slack_schedule_message
tools.description: Schedule a message to be sent to a Slack channel by required channel_id with required message text, plus optional post_at timestamp, thread_ts for threading, and reply_broadcast flag.

tools.name: slack_add_reaction
tools.description: Add an emoji reaction to a specific Slack message by required channel_id, message_ts, and emoji name.

tools.name: slack_create_canvas
tools.description: Create a new Slack canvas (collaborative document) with required title and content.

tools.name: slack_update_canvas
tools.description: Update an existing Slack canvas by required canvas_id, with required action and content, plus optional section_id targeting.
